verdict.rationale: The product is itself an official SDK. It ships first-party Python (`pip install claude-agent-sdk`) and TypeScript packages, maintained in an official anthropics GitHub repo. The docs cover configuration options, examples, and production hosting. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs' developer experience beyond first-party docs and repos.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Claude Code, programmable in Python and TypeScript.
The SDK bundles a native Claude Code binary for your platform as an optional dependency such as `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64`.
TypeScript applications live in the `claude-agent-sdk-demos` repo, and Python recipes live in the Claude Cookbook.
